prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Explanation Banner: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in with their original provider restores their existing pets and data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use the same login method as before to restore your existing pets and progress."}}
1: [adoption, layout] Grid View Pet Selection: Swaps the pet selection screen to a clean grid layout so users can see all available pet options at a glance.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid"}}
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Welcome & Experience Preview Screen: Inserts a new introductory screen right after the story screen highlighting what to expect from your new companion.
   config: {"choose_path": {"_order": ["story", "new_welcome_overview", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_welcome_overview": {"headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose a preset pet or design a custom companion that lives right on your desktop.", "button_label": "Get Started", "layout": "centered"}}
3: [home, wait_info] Generation Time Estimate Indicator: Shows explicit estimated time remaining and progress indicator on the waiting screen while pet assets generate.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "hint": "Pet generation usually takes around 2-3 minutes. You can safely minimize this window."}}
4: [adoption, redesign] Preset Pet Selection Cards Redesign: Redesigns the friend choice area with choice cards component featuring distinct visual tags for instant selection.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose a starter companion style", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}}
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Toggle: Adds a notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "We're preparing your pet!"}}
6: [choose_path, new_flow] Companion Archetype Quiz Flow: Adds an interactive quiz screen before path choice that recommends the ideal pet personality archetype.
   config: {"choose_path": {"_order": ["story", "new_quiz_path", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_quiz_path": {"headline": "What kind of companion do you need today?", "body": "Answer 2 quick questions to find your matching desktop companion vibe.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select your ideal pet energy", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}]}}
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Explanation Copy: Updates home_intro body copy to explicitly instruct users how to interact, drag, hide, and summon their pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, customize, or open settings. Drag with your mouse to move them around your screen."}}
8: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Summary Screen: Adds a quick desktop control key guide screen right after home intro, detailing desktop shortcuts before completing.
   config: {"home_intro": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_summary"]}, "new_controls_summary": {"headline": "Essential Desktop Shortcuts", "body": "Right-click pet: Menu & Settings | Drag: Move pet | Double-click: Interact", "button_label": "Start Playing", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "Quick Controls Overview", "style": "rounded", "action": "next"}]}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Starter Accessory Selection Incentive: Adds a visual badge and headline offering a free starter accessory when completing photo upload.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Photos & Claim Free Starter Scarf", "hint": "Your uploaded photo unlocks an exclusive custom color theme for your pet's first accessory."}}

Adds accurate wait time indicator on waiting screen without false urgency.
Redesigns pet selection cards while fulfilling the job of picking a friend.
Adds a notification toggle on the waiting screen within onboarding limits.
Adds a quiz screen to onboarding while retaining all required steps.
Updates home intro copy within onboarding rules.
Adds a summary screen following home intro as permitted by Rule 4.
